title.narrative: “CO-CHAIRS’ RETREAT” DEL PARTENARIATO GLOBALE PER LA COOPERAZIONE ALLO SVILUPPO EFFICACE (GPEDC)

description.narrative: Contributo volontario all'OCSE/DCD per supportare, che servirà come una sessione di lavoro strutturata per la proposta di valore emergente del GPEDC 2026 e il cui contributo mira a supportare gli aspetti logistici, il supporto e il follow-up del lavoro dei Co-Presidenti; finanzierà inoltre la comunicazione e l'advocacy del ritiro

Voluntary contribution to OECD/DCD to support which will serve as a structured working session for emerging GPEDC Value Proposition 2026 and contribution aims to support logistical aspects, support, and follow-up of the work of the Co-Chairs' also fund communication and advocacy of the retreat

tag.narrative: Developed countries to implement fully their official development assistance commitments, including the commitment by many developed countries to achieve the target of 0.7 per cent of gross national income for official development assistance (ODA/GNI) to developing countries and 0.15 to 0.20 per cent of ODA/GNI to least developed countries; ODA providers are encouraged to consider setting a target to provide at least 0.20 per cent of ODA/GNI to least developed countries
Encourage and promote effective public, public-private and civil society partnerships, building on the experience and resourcing strategies of partnerships

Enhance international support for implementing effective and targeted capacity-building in developing countries to support national plans to implement all the Sustainable Development Goals, including through North-South, South-South and triangular cooperation

Enhance the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development, complemented by multi-stakeholder partnerships that mobilize and share knowledge, expertise, technology and financial resources, to support the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals in all countries, in particular developing countries
Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development
